title: Slippery
text: Slippery. 1st off I have to let you know that this rug does not have a rubber backing and that means when it's on the floor it will slip Hardwood or tiles. I put this on top of another rug because of that. I imagine it is dangerous with the easy if slipping like this. It is a nice thick and soft rug though.
